U10 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
One cell line, one drug, one receptor, and a fast nuclear-receptor response.
The half-time summarises a curve and discards its shape: an overshoot and a monotone
rise with the same midpoint are recorded identically, and overshoot is the signature
negative feedback is supposed to produce, so this statistic understates what a
feedback test could find.
Topology is CollecTRI curation from other cell lines; a two-cycle curated elsewhere
need not be wired in A549 and no gate here can see that.
Dropping replicate 4 and the 5, 300 and 360 minute points costs power and early
resolution. That is the price of a constant replicate composition and it is paid
deliberately, because loop 191 shows what the alternative produces.
Bulk RNA averages over the population, so a fast response in a subpopulation and a
slow one everywhere give the same curve.
